tooltip.old_glass_photograph.plate.blank: Coat it in a Darkroom Table. Close the lid holding a Collodion Kit.
tooltip.old_glass_photograph.plate.wet: Wet. Load it into a Wet Plate Camera, then shoot from behind it.
tooltip.old_glass_photograph.plate.expos: Latent image. Develop it in a Darkroom Table. Close the lid holding Developer.
tooltip.old_glass_photograph.plate.devel: Hold Fixer in your other hand, then hold right-click to finish the photograph.
tooltip.old_glass_photograph.camera.faci: The lens points the way you are facing when you place it.
tooltip.old_glass_photograph.camera.stan: Stand close behind it and right-click to look through it.
viewfinder.old_glass_photograph.bright: Bright light. The plate takes quickly.
viewfinder.old_glass_photograph.soft: Soft light. The exposure will run longer.
viewfinder.old_glass_photograph.dim: Dim light. The exposure will run a long time.
viewfinder.old_glass_photograph.too_dark: Too dark. The plate will not take a full image here.
viewfinder.old_glass_photograph.no_plate: No plate loaded. Sneak to step back, then load a wet plate.
viewfinder.old_glass_photograph.already_: This plate already holds a latent image. Sneak-click to take it out.
viewfinder.old_glass_photograph.not_sens: Not sensitized. Coat it in a Darkroom Table with a Collodion Kit.
viewfinder.old_glass_photograph.dried: The collodion dried out. Coat the plate again and reload it.
viewfinder.old_glass_photograph.would_dr: The plate would dry out mid-exposure. Load a freshly coated one.
viewfinder.old_glass_photograph.shoot_hi: %s Look around to frame the shot. Click again to open the shutter.
message.old_glass_photograph.plate.dried: The collodion dried out. The plate is clean again.
message.old_glass_photograph.plate.load_: Load this plate into a Wet Plate Camera and expose it.
message.old_glass_photograph.plate.use_d: Open a Darkroom Table, put the plate in, then close the lid holding %s.
message.old_glass_photograph.darkroom.li: The lid is shut. Right-click with an empty hand to open the box.
message.old_glass_photograph.darkroom.wo: The box is working on a plate.
message.old_glass_photograph.darkroom.pl: The plate is in. Hold %s and right-click to close the lid.
message.old_glass_photograph.darkroom.li: Light is getting in. The plate will fog.
message.old_glass_photograph.darkroom.op: The box is open. Right-click with a plate to put it in.
message.old_glass_photograph.darkroom.pl: A plate is waiting. Hold %s and close the lid to start.
message.old_glass_photograph.darkroom.ne: Hold %s in your hand and close the lid. The plate is safe inside.
message.old_glass_photograph.darkroom.dr: The collodion dried out inside the box. The plate is clean again.
message.old_glass_photograph.darkroom.st: The lid is shut. Coating and sensitizing the plate.
The lid is shut. Developing the plate.
message.old_glass_photograph.camera.alre: This plate already holds a latent image. Develop it first.
message.old_glass_photograph.camera.not_: This plate is not sensitized. Coat it with a Collodion Kit first.
message.old_glass_photograph.camera.plat: Plate loaded. Stand behind the camera and right-click to look through it.
message.old_glass_photograph.camera.stan: You have to stand close behind the camera to look through it.
You have to stand close behind the camera to take the shot.
message.old_glass_photograph.camera.plat: The plate dried out inside the camera. The plate is clean again.
message.old_glass_photograph.camera.too_: You are too far from the camera.
message.old_glass_photograph.camera.noth: The shutter closed before any light reached the plate. Nothing was exposed.
message.old_glass_photograph.exposure.no: Exposed. The plate holds a latent image.
message.old_glass_photograph.exposure.un: Underexposed. It is too dark here to fill the plate. Bring light.
Underexposed. The shutter closed before the plate had gathered enough light.
